design: Slender agile adult street guard with warm yellow-tan speckled hide, narrow exposed four-mandibled face, low elongated brow, thin dreadlocks in a compact high knot with a few free cheek locks. Lightweight asymmetrical layered leather-and-bronze chest harness with circular central plate, one long left leather sleeve, right arm bare, fitted trousers under two short triangular hip flaps, low ankle wraps. Long baton sheathed crosswise behind belt, one hand adjusts wrist communicator while other held close to waist. Natural idle pose.
